message.reasoning_content:
The watch is an Audemars Piguet Royal Oak. Blue dial with "AP" logo at 12 actually — the "AP" applied logo is below center in this photo, and "Audemars Piguet Automatic" at 12. Date at 3. This is the Royal Oak "Jumbo" Extra-Thin 15202ST with blue dial? The 15202ST has "AP" logo at 12 and Audemars Piguet Automatic below. Hmm.

Actually the classic 15202ST (Jumbo) has: Audemars Piguet logo at 12, "AUTOMATIC" below, and AP applied logo at 6. That matches this photo — "AUDEMARS PIGUET / AUTOMATIC" at 12 and the "AP" logo at 6 above "SWISS MADE". Yes! That's the 15202ST layout.

The 15202ST blue dial reference is 15202ST.OO.1240ST.01. Yes, that's the Jumbo Extra-Thin with blue "Petite Tapisserie" dial, steel, 39mm, caliber 2121.

The 15500ST has AP logo at 12 and "AUDEMARS PIGUET AUTOMATIC" below it. So this is 15202ST.

Reference: 15202ST.OO.1240ST.01. Confidence maybe 0.75. But the current-generation 16202ST has same layout too. Hmm, 16202ST blue dial = 16202ST.OO.1240ST.01. The 16202 is 50th anniversary. Visually similar. But the classic listing would be 15202ST.

I'll go with 15202ST.OO.1240ST.01, confidence 0.6.

Movement: automatic. Case: stainless-steel. Bracelet: metal.

Also the rotor — 15202 has no seconds hand and thin. There's no seconds hand visible in the photo, consistent with 15202 (no seconds) — 16202 also has no seconds. Fine.

I'll say model_family: "Royal Oak Jumbo Extra-Thin".
